record: AISEF V2 — P10 LedgerLock workload in V2 form (PLAN-V2.1's 77 criteria, their kinds, the kernel's typed answers)

FR-2.title: SHA-256 hash chain over canonical bytes

FR-7.title: Verifier does not trust in-memory cache

FR-14.title: No network, no subprocess, no extra files

criteria.criterion: Given any string `s`, `from ledgerlock.format import normalize_key; normalize_key(s)` returns `unicodedata.normalize("NFC", s)` byte-for-byte.
criteria.note: one instance of 'any string s': the NFD form

criteria.criterion: Given the NFC string `"\u00e9"` (U+00E9) and its NFD decomposition `"e\u0301"`, calling `normalize_key` on each returns byte-identical results equal to `"\u00e9"`.
